checks.description: Changing visible labels inside a sufficient reserve does not move surrounding native layout or resize the reserve.
Hidden inaccessible reserve remains in layout; visible text sits in an absolute-fill vertically centered overlay without absolute positioning its own Text.

tests.name: LayoutStableText reserves layout with hidden text and overlays the visible text

checks.description: Caller width and distinct visible typography/numberOfLines survive while overlay shares available width and structural flexShrink is retained.

tests.name: LayoutStableText centers smaller visible text without replacing its typography or wrapping constraints

checks.description: Measured visible line height is positive and smaller than large reserve; vertical centers agree within one layout pixel, without stretching visible Text.
Both labels wrap/truncate in the same available width; sufficient reserve handles every visible state without geometry shift.
Visible label preserves accessible name and synthetic press while overlay is inaccessible with box-none hit testing.

tests.name: LayoutStableText preserves visible text semantics and interaction through the overlay

checks.description: Root remains inaccessible and forwards unowned native root/ref/test props; native overlay does not intercept owning control or visible Text input.
Compiled types require actual reserve/visible text elements and reject caller children.
Review native glyph ink and caret placement with small visible line in large reserve and different text weights/scaling.
Only visible label supplies native semantics; reserve and root are absent from screen-reader traversal.

limitations: The type fixture uses null as never, so it does not prove valid required element shapes or independently reject missing reserve/visible.
Synthetic layout-event forwarding is not measured native geometry and is not linked as such.
Overview has an intrinsic-height native callback, but no catalog-verified exact identity or execution record is linked here; native geometry remains an explicit gap.
